contexts.text: The Angels prevent him from precipitating himself into ultimate evil.
This proprium desires nothing so much as to precipitate itself into Hell.
It is the man himself who precipitates himself into Hell. AC 1861:12.
When they approach the first threshold... they precipitate themselves backwards.
They precipitate themselves thence. AC 2438:3. AC 2733:2. AC 2749. AC 3938:6. AC 6677:2.
Unless Angels and Spirits were with men... they would precipitate themselves into the deepest Hell.
Unless man were withheld by the Lord, he would continually precipitate himself into the deepest Hell. AC 6484:2. AC 6489:end.
Therefore they cast themselves down headlong. AC 9281:2. HH 525:end. DLW 423.
They cast themselves down by a precipice, which then appears to them. CL 10.
If the successive order of conjugial love is precipitated...
That conjugial love precipitated without order... burns up the marrows, and is consumed. Explained.
If anyone had been admitted (into spiritual temptation), he would have... precipitated himself more deeply into Hell.
When the Lord shows Himself more fully... some precipitate themselves deeper into Hell.
Lest they precipitate them into slaughter.
Man continually studies to precipitate himself into the worst evil.
They ran by a headlong way... When I awoke, I thought (with horror) of that precipice...
They precipitate themselves into the penalties.
Those who precipitate themselves (or the rash) () = those who easily seize upon and believe the things which are said; thus falsities also.
